runs.title: Second check: 15 new fruit fly brain projects, a Doom control study and two viral claims that do not hold up
runs.summary: 58 entries and 40 videos re-checked about 22 hours after the first pass: no changes, 0 link problems. 15 new entries (5 A, 1 B, 5 C, 2 D, 2 not graded) and 4 new videos. A third-party control study found that a brainless constant autopilot survives in Doom about as long as DOOMFLY's full brain (51.9 s vs 53.3 s); the Half-Life video's connectome claim is contradicted by its code (grade D). New project pages for DOOMFLY and the Shiu et al. model.

runs.title: Video gallery: 40 fruit fly brain videos checked, and an inline-player test
runs.summary: 40 videos matched to the catalogue (35 original uploads, 5 reposts or commentary; 21 of 58 entries now have a video), each with its catalogue grade and what it does not show. YouTube, Vimeo, TikTok and X players all failed inside the site's sandboxed frames, so videos open on their original platform.

runs.title: First catalogue check: fruit fly brain simulation projects, viral claims and a tested beginner project
runs.summary: 58 projects graded from code, verdicts on 12 viral claims, 13 controlled studies, 7 connectome datasets compared, and a beginner simulation run from an empty folder on 2 CPUs (MN9 85.2 Hz with real wiring, 0 Hz with shuffled wiring).
